descriptions.d16b_blend_toward_input_800abc18: Clamp an input to plus or minus the controller range scalar, map it to (input / range + 1) * 0.5, move the blend value toward that target by the rate scalar and clamp the blend to [0, 1], using const-reference min/max selections. Scalars read through the original accessor; partial layout; owns the 12-byte literal pool 0x80381c20..0x80381c2b (1.0f, 0.5f, 0.0f). Compiled with the original paired-single float switch -mps-float (reserves the FPR pair frame slots).
